claims.statement: Two highs at a comparable level separated by a pullback, forming a resistance the second attempt failed to clear. The neckline is the low between the two highs.
claims.source_title: Chart patterns for crypto trading, patterns explained

claims.test_note: A definition describes a shape; there is nothing to test.
claims.status_note: This is an EDUCATIONAL CLAIM about how to read charts. It is not a market fact and carries no authority over measured data.
